Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 15
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the New York Times article’s publication date (Nov. 13, 1977) as the election date, despite the article text indicating the election occurred on Nov. 12, 1977 (“NEW ORLEANS, Nov. 12 — Ernest N. Morial was elected…”). This conflation led the process toward confirming an incorrect exact date.
